label: RANBP2::ALK

sections.text: RANBP2 encodes a nuclear-pore-associated protein with transport and SUMO-ligase functions.
ALK encodes a receptor tyrosine kinase involved in neural development.

The fusion retains the ALK kinase region and replaces normal receptor regulation with an amino-terminal partner, producing constitutive signaling. RANBP2::ALK is associated with epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma and often nuclear-membrane ALK staining.
The RANBP2::ALK-associated epithelioid sarcoma phenotype has a more aggressive course than conventional inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor.
Crizotinib is US-approved for ALK-positive unresectable, recurrent or refractory inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor in adults and children aged at least 1 year.
